name: ghost-qa
displayName: ghost-qa — Autonomous Browser QA for Coding Agents
description: Autonomous headless browser QA & self-healing verification loop for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf). Crawls a running localhost app on Desktop 1440x900 and Mobile 390x844, safely exercises interactive controls, and traps console/hydration errors, failed network requests, layout overflow, accessibility defects and performance problems — returning a structured Self-Healing Bug Report the agent fixes before reporting done.

tools.name: ghost_qa_audit_url
tools.description: Run the full ghost-qa headless browser audit against a running localhost app: crawls internal routes on Desktop 1440x900 and Mobile 390x844, safely exercises interactive controls, and traps console/hydration errors, failed network requests, layout overflow, accessibility bugs and performance problems. Returns the Self-Healing Bug Report — fix every critical/major issue it reports before declaring the task done.

url.description: Target URL of the running app, e.g. http://localhost:3000

tools.name: ghost_qa_doctor
tools.description: Verify ghost-qa environment readiness: Node.js version, Chromium binary availability, and a live headless-browser smoke test. Run this first when an audit fails to start.
